messages:
olivia_docs: Quick sync 1 opening a PR to convert the Dedicated provisioning guide to MDX so we can embed the SDK snippets inline. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1301

marco_dev: Nice. Can you include both Python + Go SDK snippets? Some platform teams prefer Go examples.

olivia_docs: Yep; planning to add a compact Go example for creating reserved pools and a Python one for reading SLA metadata. Pasted drafts: 
```py
# python: create reserved pool
from redwood import DedicatedClient
client = DedicatedClient()
client.create_pool(name='team-pool', gpu='a10x', autoscale={'min':1,'max':3})
```
```go
// go: create reserved pool (pseudo)
package main
import "github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-go"
func main() {
  c := sdk.New()
  c.CreatePool("team-pool", "a10x", 1, 3)
}
```

rachel_prod: Tiny wording request: call out that `gpu` values are case-sensitive in the API. Also add a short note that `min` is advisory when the system is under hardware pressure.

nick_infra: Also flag: several internal links in the MDX will point to /handbook which is stale. Can you update links to the new canonical path: https://confluence.redwood.ai/dedicated/ops-guides ? I'll push a redirect but better if docs point to final URL.

olivia_docs: Good catch. I'll batch replace /handbook references. Also adding an anchor link to the SLA table in Confluence.

marco_dev: For the terraform snippet, instead of full module example, please include a one-liner that shows the label mapping we expect:
```hcl
# label mapping
resource "redwood_dedicated_pool" "team" {
  name = "team-pool"
  labels = { owned_by = "team-alpha" }
}
```

olivia_docs: I'm debating if the MDX quickstart should include a small "troubleshooting" callout: common error `QuotaExceeded` when migrations overlap. Thoughts?

rachel_prod: Add it as a small aside. Example: `QuotaExceeded` can happen during tenant->reserved migration; recommend running migration during a maintenance window and verifying `reserved_pool_capacity` before switching.

docs-bot: lint:mdx  passed for PR #1301  no broken anchors detected.

ci-bot: preview site built: https://deploy-preview.redwood.dev/docs/dedicated/quickstart/1301 

nick_infra: One more infra note: please avoid implying "absolute hardware isolation" in the text. Use phrasing: "tenant isolation reduces noisy neighbor risk but does not guarantee dedicated hardware unless explicitly requested in contract."

olivia_docs: Will do. I'll push updates for wording, replace links, and add the Terraform one-liner + Go/Python snippets. Assigning reviewers @marco_dev and @nick_infra. Target small merge next Tue.

marco_dev: I'll review. Also leaving a tiny comment on the Go snippet to include error handling in the final doc.

olivia_docs: Thanks 609  pinging when updated.
